summary: Backend testing of newly implemented (1) inventory auto-deduction after successful payment and (2) order confirmation email GST breakdown with INR formatting. Created pytest suite with 7 tests covering: format_inr helper, deduct_inventory() function (happy path, insufficient stock cap-at-zero, multiple items), email template HTML generation (GST badges, subtotal/GST/total INR formatting, fallback calculation), and end-to-end flow (clinic creates order via API → simulate paid → verify stock decreased + verify GST fields persisted in DB). ALL 7 TESTS PASSED.

minor.issue: OrderResponse Pydantic model (server.py lines 452-473) does not expose 'subtotal_amount' or 'gst_amount' fields. They are correctly persisted to DB by create_order, but stripped from the API response. As a result clinic UI cannot read the GST breakdown of a created order from the create/get order endpoints (only total_amount is returned). The email template reads from the DB document directly so emails are unaffected, but UI integration for order details will silently drop GST data.

Idempotency is correct in get_checkout_status (checks payment_status != 'paid' before deducting), but the stripe_webhook handler at lines 2189-2235 does NOT perform the same idempotency check before calling deduct_inventory(). If the webhook fires after the checkout/status polling already processed the order, deduct_inventory will be invoked twice → stock could be decremented twice. Recommend gating webhook deduction on the same 'was previously not paid' check.

Non-atomic in the fallback path: when stock < quantity, function does an UPDATE_ONE to set stock=0 separately from the initial conditional update. Two concurrent paid notifications for the same order could still race. Also: insufficient-stock case still returns True (success) — caller cannot distinguish 'fully deducted' from 'partially deducted/sold out'.

action_items: Add subtotal_amount and gst_amount to OrderResponse Pydantic model so the clinic UI can display GST breakdown on order detail pages (consistency with email).

Add idempotency guard inside stripe_webhook before calling deduct_inventory() (mirror the 'payment_status != paid' check from get_checkout_status) to prevent double-deduction when both checkout/status polling and webhook fire for the same order.
Consider returning a structured result from deduct_inventory (e.g., per-item deducted/short) so the caller can flag partial fulfilment to admin/vendor.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2745 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline. Should be split into modules (auth, orders, products, payments, email).
Duplicate inventory-deduction call sites (get_checkout_status + stripe_webhook) share email + clinic lookup logic - extract to a helper finalize_paid_order(order) to keep both paths in sync.
OrderResponse model omitting subtotal_amount/gst_amount despite being part of the data model is an oversight given GST is core to this feature.
seed_data_creation: Tests insert and clean up TEST_PROD_* products and one TEST_ORD_* order within fixtures - no permanent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_inventory_and_email_gst.py covers: format_inr unit, deduct_inventory direct calls (basic / insufficient / multi-item), send_order_confirmation_email HTML inspection via monkey-patched send_email (captures html_content and asserts INR ₹, Subtotal, GST, Grand Total, per-item 'X% GST' badges), and an end-to-end clinic API order creation followed by simulated paid->deduct_inventory verifying stock decrement and that subtotal_amount/gst_amount are stored in the DB document. pytest.ini sets asyncio_default_fixture_loop_scope=session so motor's global db client stays bound to one loop. Note that OrderResponse doesn't include subtotal_amount/gst_amount - main agent should add them.

features_verified.email_gst_breakdown_inr: WORKING - send_order_confirmation_email HTML contains '₹' symbol, Subtotal/GST/Grand Total rows formatted with format_inr (e.g. ₹749.98, ₹126.00, ₹875.98), and per-item GST percentage badges (e.g. '18% GST', '12% GST'). Falls back to deriving subtotal from items/total when subtotal_amount is missing on the order doc.
features_verified.order_doc_gst_persistence: WORKING - create_order stores subtotal_amount, gst_amount, total_amount, and per-item gst_percentage / gst_amount in MongoDB.
